purpose: Policy-aligned temporal golden set: the 14 other temporal-golden-v1 cases unchanged, T02 replaced by an explicit negative case and the two positive enactment variants. Labels below were written from the policy before this file was evaluated; they are not derived from implementation output. This is a different benchmark from temporal-golden-v1: its scores are not comparable to, and are not an improvement on, the 14/15 recorded for temporal-golden-v1.

label_rules.baseline: The source(s) whose rule applies to the question at as_of. Empty with decision ABSTAIN when the records cannot decide.

temporal_status.NO_CONFLICT: No competing source was ever applicable to the question at as_of in scope (not yet published or effective, unapproved draft, other project or batch, or not a directive).
temporal_status.RESOLVED_BY_RECORD: A competing source that is or was applicable in scope is overridden by recorded precedence (newer approved revision, recorded supersession, expiry).
temporal_status.UNRESOLVED: Recorded dates, approvals and supersession cannot decide, or the guidance leaves the question open.

label_rules.temporal_review_required: True when a team lead must settle precedence or an open question before acting.
label_rules.documentation_update_target: A published source that still states a rule the records show is no longer current (it should be corrected); null otherwise. A superseded revision kept as history is not a target.
label_rules.must_not_win: Sources that would be a false override if chosen as the baseline.
label_rules.prepared_judgments: Semantic inputs the drafting/grounding models would provide (which sources the draft cites on the question, which pairs state different rules, announcement relevance/directive, current-source agreement, open question). Labelled PREPARED; they never name the expected winner. A conflict is only declared between sources present in the bundle the draft saw.
label_rules.policy: Optional per-case labels scored separately from joint accuracy (joint keeps the v1 fields): uses = the evidence use each source must have for the question section (eligibility); governing_sources = the source named as governing an enacted decision (a linked announcement or guideline first, else the decision itself when its record states enactment); enactment_gaps = the enactment conditions a decision fails (NO_ENACTMENT_EVIDENCE: nothing records that the policy change was put into effect).

decision_supports_current_handling_only_: authorized team-lead approval of the specific instruction
applicable project, batch and section scope
an effective date at or before as_of

enactment of that policy change: a later, current, in-scope announcement posted by a team lead or an updated guideline that links the decision through source_refs, or the decision's own recorded policy_enacted state; not approval alone, a copied draft, a completed escalation or a generic posted/executed/completed status
no applicable expiry, supersession or withdrawal
enactment_policy.governing_source: A linked announcement or updated guideline is the primary governing source; the decision keeps its own document type and recorded states.
enactment_policy.unverified_replacement: An approved decision that declares it supersedes guidance, without established enactment, is an unverified replacement: it is not current handling and its supersession is not applied.
enactment_policy.eligible_older_guideline: The guidance it claims to replace stays eligible evidence (current, flagged as under an unverified supersession claim). It is NOT permitted as a provisional decided baseline: while the supersession claim is unresolved the records cannot decide which rule applies (label rule UNRESOLVED: "recorded dates, approvals and supersession cannot decide"), so the case abstains with temporal review required, and the guidance is not an update target.
enactment_policy.withdrawal: Explicit withdrawal with no replacement is not unverified supersession: the withdrawn guidance is not current, no earlier revision returns, and the case abstains for that reason.

changes_from_v1.mismatch: The v1 label (DECIDED with D, RESOLVED_BY_RECORD, update target G) requires D to be enacted; T02's recorded evidence has no enactment (execution_status 'posted' on an advice_review record, outcome not_observed, no linked announcement or guideline). Under the enactment policy the label is not supported by the case contents.

prepared_judgment_corrections.change: question_section added: the draft cites only the section that addresses the question (as T08 already did). The first run cited every chunk of a multi-section source, which put an unrelated current section of the help page into T09's baseline. Expected outcomes unchanged.

expected.rationale: T02 as recorded.
